title: 🧑️ semio repo contributors
$comment: 🧬️ The wire contract of the 🧑️contributors module: the stored `🧑️‍💻️contributor.json` document, the session record derived from a session's own event files, the checkpoint parsed out of the git log, and the fixture files under 🧫️fixtures. ContributorDocument states the member names and the `omitempty` rule exactly as the Go struct tags declare them, so a real document taken out of `.🧬semio/🦑️repo/🧑️‍💻️devs` validates against it unchanged.

SessionKind.$comment: 🚦️ What became of a session: still writing events, ended with an agent-ended event, or stopped without ending.

ContributorDocument.$comment: 🧑️ A stored `🧑️‍💻️contributor.json`. The directory name stands in for a blank alias or handle. `email` carries no `omitempty` tag, so the encoder always writes it, but hand-written documents in this repository omit it — only the members every stored document carries are required.

GitAuthor.$comment: ✍️ A `Name <email>` author line split into its parts.

Session.$comment: 💿️ One session of one agent on one day, assembled from the session directory's own files.

Checkpoint.$comment: 🏁️ One entry of the checkpoint log.

ContributorDocumentVectors.$comment: 🧑️ 🧫️fixtures/🧑️‍💻️contributor-documents.json — real documents copied verbatim out of this repository's own devs tree, each with the directory name it sits under.

CheckpointLogVectors.$comment: 🏁️ 🧫️fixtures/🏁️checkpoint-log.json — real git output plus the lines a reader has to reject.

SessionVectors.$comment: 📡️ 🧫️fixtures/📡️session-vectors.json — session directories stated as their own files and the age of their newest write, one per branch of the kind derivation. These are specification vectors, not recorded data: this checkout carries no session directory to copy, which the no-oracle decision states.
